verdict.rationale: Signifyd's core product (fraud decisioning, chargeback handling, webhook notifications) runs autonomously in the background once integrated, and webhooks/API endpoints let a merchant configure automated event flows (e.g. createteamwebhook, getdecision, createchargeback) that fire without manual intervention. However, there is no evidence of an AI-native automation builder, scheduler, or agent-configurable workflow system — the 'automation' here is fixed product behavior wired via API/webhooks rather than a user-defined autonomous automation platform. Missing for 10: evidence of a user-configurable automation/rules engine, scheduling or trigger-condition builder, and any AI-specific automation tooling.
